Protect the intended audience, authorized scope, privacy boundary, and established structure of an artifact.

## When to use

Protect the audience, scope, privacy boundary, and established structure of product-facing or derived artifacts when implementation or content could drift.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link audience-scope-discipline --scope user
```

The standard destination is `~/.agents/skills`. Codex reads this universal Agent Skills location directly.

### Claude compatibility

```text

```

## Examples

### Trim a technical product screen

**Prompt**

> Use the audience-scope-discipline skill to review this settings screen. Keep only information customers need to decide or act.

**Expected outcome**

An audience-based content decision that moves operational and diagnostic detail out of the default view.

### Guard a narrow implementation

**Prompt**

> Apply the audience-scope-discipline skill while implementing this request. Do not absorb adjacent cleanup or local setup into the product.

**Expected outcome**

The smallest coherent change, with material risks challenged once and unrelated improvements left separate.
